integrity: Proof is analytic and self-contained apart from the classical uniqueness of the John ellipsoid; numerical verification supplements but does not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal-radius perpendicular filled disks with centers symmetrically displaced on common axis; no claim for unequal radii or other angles; historical priority unresolved and independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp John-ellipsoid phase transition in axially separated orthogonal disk hulls
